title: Refine UI Component With Window Kinds and Golden Layout
description: Refine UI component to use window kinds with golden-layout, move domain-neutral types
summary: Refined the UI composite component. Apps now use UIWindowConfig with UIWindowKindDefinition entries rendered by golden-layout. Moved WindowKind enum, createDefaultLayout, parseWindowLayout, stringifyWindowLayout, deduplicateWindowLayout, UIWindowControl, UIWindowKindDefinition from sketchpad/shared.ts to semio-elements/ui/elements.tsx. Sketchpad shared.ts now re-exports these from elements.tsx. UICanvas component dynamically imports golden-layout and registers each window kind. Updated storybook stories to use the new UIAppConfig with windowConfig.
